_comment: The superfleet plan (DEC-020). Ten scenarios for improving how the loop bootstraps. Each is 1 + N: one look-first step, then N lanes whose write areas do not overlap. This file describes the work; it holds no instructions for any agent. The founder writes those. Gate: tools/check-superfleet.py

scenarios.goal: Find every place where the start-of-session documents lose a newcomer.
